subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI chat picker accessibility slice after conflict resolution while leaving the broader linear workspace request open?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but the protected maintainer label, user-facing accessibility wording, and partial overlap with a broader accessibility workflow issue require maintainer UX/product acceptance.

options.title: Land the narrow picker slice
options.body: Approve the row-number and aria-label affordance after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full workspace solution.

options.title: Request UX wording changes
options.body: Ask for different visible ordinal treatment or screen-reader phrasing before merge if maintainers want a different accessibility pattern.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Hold this PR until the linear persistent workspace direction is decided, accepting that this smaller picker improvement waits.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow picker slice
recommendation.body: Approve the row-number and aria-label affordance after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full workspace solution.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent UI localization and adjacent picker history makes this the best available routing candidate for the i18n and picker merge-shape decision.
